metadata.description: XPipeline CI Flow: an optional plugin of the XBrain ecosystem that teaches agents a project's checks' policy (levels by action, kind and zone), tests that can fail, agreed skips, a heavy-run queue, local Linux CI and bench checks, for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: xpipeline-ci-flow
plugins.description: A project's checks by action, kind and zone: light on commit, the touched zones on push and merge, the whole suite once at the end of a session; tests proved red, skips with reasons, a heavy-run queue, Linux CI and an isolated bench.
